description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle database integration to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including JDBC and JPA configuration, schema and SQL conversion, PostgreSQL bytea photo storage, and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect. Convert Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents and migrate photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Update datasource configuration to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and replace plaintext database credentials with managed identity authentication.
